subject: End-of-term payment triage: split invoices & VAT evidence requested
body:
--- Message 1 of 6 ---
From: Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@greenleaf.energy>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: GreenLeaf Energy Billing <billing@greenleaf.energy>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Final invoice / PO and VAT evidence for contract closeout

Hi Vanessa,

We received the final invoice you sent for the end-of-term true-up. A couple of items before we can schedule payment:

1) We need the invoice split into two cost-center invoices (Operations PO#789045 and Labs PO#789046). Our AP system requires separate invoice numbers for each PO.
2) Please confirm the VAT handling: GreenLeaf is registered under the EU reverse-charge for cross-border services; we need your VAT exemption evidence on file or a statement that no VAT was charged.
3) Can you provide wire details and indicate whether you accept partial payment (50% Ops / 50% Labs) or if Redwood requires full settlement before releasing the service credits/rollover?

Attached: PO_789045 (Ops) — I will send PO_789046 in a follow-up.

Thanks,
Elena
Senior Procurement Manager
GreenLeaf Energy
